title: Cumulative 2026 Disaster Damage Reaches ₱21.69 Billion as Rebuild Cycle Strains Recovery
detail: The Philippines remains trapped in a disaster-rebuild cycle with cumulative 2026 disaster damage reaching ₱21.69 billion, as repeated storms and floods overwhelm recovery capacity. The cascading impact of the Mindanao earthquake, successive typhoons, and monsoon flooding has stretched NDRRMC and local government response systems, with ongoing reconstruction efforts repeatedly interrupted by new disaster events.
